MP Pension Funds Disbursed to Millions of Beneficiaries

Millions of people in Madhya Pradesh have received pension payments in their bank accounts. The state government has transferred funds to approximately 34 lakh beneficiaries under social security schemes. This disbursement aims to provide financial support to eligible individuals.
